user.title: Connect Imou Life
user.description: Sign in with the same account used by the Imou Life Android app. CAPTCHA and terminal verification are completed in the next steps when required.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Imou Life
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the current password for {account}. The same Home Assistant terminal identity will be retained.

captcha.title: Verify Imou Life CAPTCHA
captcha.description: Open the protected CAPTCHA page, finish the image verification, then return to Home Assistant. Account credentials and Imou verification tokens remain server-side.

captcha_finish.title: Finishing verification
captcha_finish.description: Home Assistant is continuing the Imou Life login.

two_step.title: Verify this Home Assistant terminal
two_step.description: Enter the six-digit code sent through {delivery}. Select resend without entering a code to request a new one.

error.invalid_auth: Imou rejected the account or password.
error.invalid_code: The verification code is invalid or expired.
error.verification_pending: Imou has not recorded this terminal permission after accepting the code. Request a new code and verify again; if it repeats, share only the response_keys/response_flags log lines, never the OTP.
error.code_send_failed: Imou could not send a verification code.
error.code_sent: A new verification code was sent.
error.captcha_unavailable: Imou did not provide a usable CAPTCHA challenge.

abort.already_configured: This Imou Life account is already configured.
abort.already_in_progress: Configuration for this Imou Life account is already in progress.
abort.captcha_unavailable: Home Assistant could not create the protected CAPTCHA page.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: The account does not match the existing Imou Life entry.
